name: OKC_K_ARTICLES_B
description: OKC_K_ARTICLES holds the use of standard and non-standard ("custom", one-time use) clauses in business documents. When associated with a document header, the clause governs the entire document. When associated with a line, the clause governs that line and all of its sublines.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique identifier. Primary key of the table.

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Major Version Number of the Contract Clause

columns.name: VERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Version Type of the Object. It can have following values "C"urrent , "A"mendment and "H"istory.

columns.name: SAV_SAE_ID
columns.description: Article ID. Foreign key to Okc_Articles_ALL

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: FULLTEXT_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether the clause should contain the full text of the clause or should be referenced by name. Obsolete in 11.5.10

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.description: Keeps earlier 40 digit ID column value before 11.5.10 contract terms  changes

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Business document type. Foreign key to Okc_bus_doc_types_b

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Business document header id. Foreign key to various business document header tables

columns.name: SOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies where the clause on a document is sourced from. Possible values are T = T&C template, R = Contract Expert Rules, M = Manual.

columns.name: MANDATORY_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the clause is mandatory. The flag is updateable for T&C Templates only.

columns.name: SCN_ID
columns.description: Section id which this clause belongs to

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Label used for numbering. Migrated from OKC section contents table

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Display Sequence. Migrated from Okc_section_contents.Content_sequence

columns.name: AMENDMENT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Text to capture amendment description for the clause.

columns.name: ARTICLE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Article version id. Foreign key to Okc_article_versions_all

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_CODE
columns.description: This will preserve the code for migrated systems such as FAR, OKCMIGR

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID1
columns.description: This will preserve id for migrated systems

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID2
columns.description: This will preserve id for migrated systems

columns.name: AMENDMENT_OPERATION_CODE
columns.description: Amendment operation code for clause. Tracks the operation from the previous document version. The possible values are INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE

columns.name: SUMMARY_AMEND_OPERATION_CODE
columns.description: Amendment operation performed on the clause. Tracks the operation from the last approved document version. Allowed operations are INSERT, CHANGE, DELETE

columns.name: CHANGE_NONSTD_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether a copy of the non-std clause needs to be created, next time when it is updated.

columns.name: PRINT_TEXT_YN
columns.description: Print amendment text or not when the document is printed

columns.name: REF_ARTICLE_ID
columns.description: Article Id of standard clause which is used to create non standard clause

columns.name: REF_ARTICLE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Article version id of standard clause which is used to create non standard clause

columns.name: ORIG_ARTICLE_ID
columns.description: Initial clause id when brought in from a template

columns.name: LAST_AMENDED_BY
columns.description: User id who amended the clause last

columns.name: LAST_AMENDMENT_DATE
columns.description: Last Amendment date when the section is amended

columns.name: SUPPRESS_CLAUSE_TITLE_PRINT
columns.description: Flag to suppress printing of clause title

columns.name: SKIP_NUMBERING
columns.description: Flag to skip numbering of clauses during numbering and printing

columns.name: CONDITIONAL
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the clause is conditionally added to the contract during run contract expert

columns.name: DISABLED
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the clause is disabled, disabled clauses are neither displayed nor printed in the contract
